resources.processScope: Go/Runtime/RTMP receiver only; not whole host, Chrome, PostgreSQL or publisher FFmpeg
resources.clockDomain: monitor local Python monotonic, independent origin; not aligned to comment timestamps
resources.limit: sampled maxima, not continuous peaks; PID starttime/reuse not verified; monitor origin is unaligned and may include pre/post-run or provider-probe samples

descriptorResources.scope: Worker original per-attempt descriptor resource claims; separate from device/process monitor, not independent hardware attestation

recordings.scope: speech-prefix / post-GPU observation band onset; not phoneme lip sync, full-segment drift or audible proof

failureCleanupObservation.scope: read-only owned SQL teardown observation; original observer failure retained

interruptDecisionToLastNarrationSample: NOT_VERIFIABLE: no independently mapped decision and last sample clock
overallAcceptance: UNCHANGED_ORIGINAL_GATE; never inferred from component metrics
